pairs.target: xìn búshì zhíjiē jìgěi tǎ wéi de .
pairs.english: The letter hadn't been addressed directly to Tavi.
pairs.hanzi: 信不是直接寄给塔维的。

pairs.target: wài fēng xiě zhe xuégōng ménfáng , lǐmiàn de xiǎo fēng cái yǒu tā de míngzì ,
pairs.english: The outer envelope named the academy gatehouse; only the smaller one inside bore his name,
pairs.hanzi: 外封写着学宫门房，里面的小封才有他的名字，

pairs.target: zì jǐ zài yíkuài shuǐzì pángbiān , xiàng gěi nà piàn qiǎnhèsè de àn ràng le lù .
pairs.english: its letters squeezed beside a water stain, as though giving way to that pale-brown shore.
pairs.hanzi: 字挤在一块水渍旁边，像给那片浅褐色的岸让了路。

pairs.target: ménfáng ràng tā qiānshōu shí , tā hái jiá zhe gāng lǐngdào de wǔcān miànbāo .
pairs.english: When the gatekeeper asked him to sign, he was still holding his freshly collected lunch bread.
pairs.hanzi: 门房让他签收时，他还夹着刚领到的午餐面包。

pairs.target: miànbāo diào le yíkuài pí , luò zài shōuxìn bó shàng .
pairs.english: A bit of crust fell onto the receipt book.
pairs.hanzi: 面包掉了一块皮，落在收信簿上。

pairs.target: tā máng zhe fúdiào , míngzì de zuìhòu yìbǐ tuō dé hěn cháng .
pairs.english: Busy brushing it away, he dragged the final stroke of his name out long.
pairs.hanzi: 他忙着拂掉，名字的最后一笔拖得很长。

pairs.target: wěi jiē . wài fēng bèihòu gài zhe zhège dìmíng .
pairs.english: Reed Steps. That place name was stamped on the back of the outer envelope.
pairs.hanzi: 苇阶。外封背后盖着这个地名。

pairs.target: tā zài láng xià chāikāi , dú dào dìsānháng , jiù bǎ zhǐ chóngxīn zhé le qǐlái .
pairs.english: He opened it under the corridor roof, read to the third line, and folded it up again.
pairs.hanzi: 他在廊下拆开，读到第三行，就把纸重新折了起来。

pairs.target: búshì kànbùdǒng .
pairs.english: It wasn't that he couldn't understand it.
pairs.hanzi: 不是看不懂。

pairs.target: tā hūrán bú yuàn zhàn zài rénláirénwǎng de dìfāng , děng zhe yǒurén cóng tā liǎnshàng cāi xìn lǐ xiě le shénme .
pairs.english: Suddenly he didn't want to stand among people passing, waiting for someone to guess the letter's contents from his face.
pairs.hanzi: 他忽然不愿站在人来人往的地方，等着有人从他脸上猜信里写了什么。

pairs.target: mǐlā zài fàntáng hòumiàn xǐ bēizi .
pairs.english: Mira was washing her cup behind the dining hall.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉在饭堂后面洗杯子。

pairs.target: tā qǐng tā bāng zìjǐ zhǎo gè dìfāng , shēngyīn yǒudiǎn yǎ .
pairs.english: He asked her to help find somewhere, his voice a little hoarse.
pairs.hanzi: 他请她帮自己找个地方，声音有点哑。

pairs.target: tā méiyǒu jiē xìn , zhī zhǐ le zhǐ lóushàng méi kāikè de xiǎoshì , suíhòu qù jiào yīwén .
pairs.english: She didn't take the letter, only pointed to an unused classroom upstairs, then went to fetch Iven.
pairs.hanzi: 她没有接信，只指了指楼上没开课的小室，随后去叫伊文。

pairs.target: sāngè rén yán cè tī shàngqù , yīwén bǎ yìbēi shuǐ gē zài zhuōshàng , lí xìn hěn yuǎn .
pairs.english: The three went up the side stairs; Iven put a cup of water on the table, far from the letter.
pairs.hanzi: 三个人沿侧梯上去，伊文把一杯水搁在桌上，离信很远。

pairs.target: xiěxìn de rén shǔmíng lín yuán , céng tì jiù yú wān zhàn chāoguò jìn chūhuòdān .
pairs.english: The writer signed as Lin Yuan, who had once copied freight manifests for the old Elmbay station.
pairs.hanzi: 写信的人署名林沅，曾替旧榆湾站抄过进出货单。

pairs.target: shōuxìn chù bǎ tǎ wéi de xúnwèn zhuǎn le guòqù .
pairs.english: The receiving office had forwarded Tavi's inquiry.
pairs.hanzi: 收信处把塔维的询问转了过去。

pairs.target: xìn lǐ dìyījù jiùshì : méiyǒu jiàn guò nàge háizi , bùnéng tì tā zhǐrèn jiārén .
pairs.english: The letter began by saying: they had never seen that child and could not identify his family for him.
pairs.hanzi: 信里第一句就是：没有见过那个孩子，不能替他指认家人。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi yǐjīng dú guò zhè jù , dìèrbiàn réng tíng le yíxià .
pairs.english: Tavi had already read that sentence, yet paused again the second time.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维已经读过这句，第二遍仍停了一下。

pairs.target: " wǒ niàn ? " mǐlā wèn . tā yáotóu , zìjǐ jìxù wǎngxiàdú .
pairs.english: “Shall I read?” Mira asked. He shook his head and continued himself.
pairs.hanzi:
“我念？”米拉问。
他摇头，自己继续往下读。

pairs.target: lín yuán shuō , jiùzhàn jiēguò sāngè fāngxiàng de huí yùn chē ké ,
pairs.english: Lin Yuan said the old station had received returning vehicle shells from three directions;
pairs.hanzi: 林沅说，旧站接过三个方向的回运车壳，

pairs.target: jízhōng hòu guà yú wān de huí yùn pái .
pairs.english: after collection, they were tagged as Elmbay return hauls.
pairs.hanzi: 集中后挂榆湾的回运牌。

pairs.target: zhìyú gètiáo jiù zhīlù , dé lìng zhǎo zǒuguò nàxiē lù de rén wèn ;
pairs.english: As for the old branch routes, he would have to ask people who had travelled them;
pairs.hanzi: 至于各条旧支路，得另找走过那些路的人问；

pairs.target: dānpíng zhèkuài pái , bùnéng pànduàn chē ké yuánxiān zài nǎ yízhàn gōngzuò .
pairs.english: the tag alone couldn't establish which station the shell had originally served.
pairs.hanzi: 单凭这块牌，不能判断车壳原先在哪一站工作。

pairs.target: xìn zhōng méiyǒu rènchū cǎotú shàng de jīqì , yě méiyǒu xǔnuò zhǎodào dāngnián de huòdān .
pairs.english: The letter didn't identify the machine in the sketch or promise to find the old manifests.
pairs.hanzi: 信中没有认出草图上的机器，也没有许诺找到当年的货单。

pairs.target: zhǐ fānguòlái , bèimiàn lìng yǒu jǐháng .
pairs.english: Turning the paper over revealed a few more lines on the back.
pairs.hanzi: 纸翻过来，背面另有几行。

pairs.target: jiùzhàn de yìzhī guìzi dǎotā shí pào guò shuǐ , hòulái bānshàngqù de zhàngcè bìng bù qíquán .
pairs.english: One cupboard at the old station had fallen and been soaked; the ledgers later moved uphill were incomplete.
pairs.hanzi: 旧站的一只柜子倒塌时泡过水，后来搬上去的账册并不齐全。

pairs.target: xiànzài ruò yào chá , zuìhǎo xiān zhīdào dàgài de niánfèn hé chē ké shàng hái néng biànrèn de biānhào .
pairs.english: To search now, it would help to know the approximate year and any number still legible on the shell.
pairs.hanzi: 现在若要查，最好先知道大概的年份和车壳上还能辨认的编号。

pairs.target: lín yuán bìngfēi jiào tā bié wèn , zhǐshì bú yuàn tā bái děng yígè xiànchéng de dáàn .
pairs.english: Lin Yuan wasn't telling him to stop asking, only unwilling to let him wait in vain for a ready-made answer.
pairs.hanzi: 林沅并非叫他别问，只是不愿他白等一个现成的答案。

pairs.target: yīwén zhòu zhe méi , méi shuōhuà . " yě jiùshì sāngè dìfāng . " tǎ wéi shuō .
pairs.english: Iven frowned without speaking. “So, three places,” Tavi said.
pairs.hanzi:
伊文皱着眉，没说话。
“也就是三个地方。”塔维说。

pairs.target: " bùzhǐ . " yīwén bǎshǒu fàngzài zhuō yán , méiyǒu pèng nà fēngxìn ,
pairs.english: “More.” Iven rested his hand on the table's edge without touching the letter.
pairs.hanzi: “不止。”伊文把手放在桌沿，没有碰那封信，

pairs.target: " shì sāngè fāngxiàng . měi tiáo lùshang kěnéng yǒu hǎojǐgè zhàn . "
pairs.english: “Three directions. Each road might have several stations.”
pairs.hanzi: “是三个方向。每条路上可能有好几个站。”

pairs.target: tǎ wéi dītóu kànzhe nà jǐgè zì .
pairs.english: Tavi lowered his head to look at those words.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维低头看着那几个字。

pairs.target: gāngcái zài ménfáng , tā jīhū yǐjīng kànjiàn le yìtiáo lù ,
pairs.english: Back at the gatehouse, he'd almost seen a road already,
pairs.hanzi: 刚才在门房，他几乎已经看见了一条路，

pairs.target: fǎngfú shùnzhe tā xiàqù , jiù huì yǒurén zài mǒu yíshànmén hòu děng zhe .
pairs.english: as though following it down would lead to someone waiting behind a certain door.
pairs.hanzi: 仿佛顺着它下去，就会有人在某一扇门后等着。

pairs.target: xiànzài nàtiáo lù hūrán fēn de hěn yuǎn .
pairs.english: Now that road suddenly branched far apart.
pairs.hanzi: 现在那条路忽然分得很远。

pairs.target: mǐlā bāikāi tā de miànbāo , bǎ jiàodà de yíbàn fàng huí tā shǒubiān .
pairs.english: Mira broke his bread and put the larger half beside his hand.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉掰开他的面包，把较大的一半放回他手边。

pairs.target: tā zìjǐ nà bànkuài bìng bù jí zhe chī .
pairs.english: She wasn't in a hurry to eat her own half.
pairs.hanzi: 她自己那半块并不急着吃。

pairs.target: nèi fēng lǐ hái jiá le yìzhāng jiù gàoshì de chāojiàn .
pairs.english: The inner envelope also contained a copy of an old notice.
pairs.hanzi: 内封里还夹了一张旧告示的抄件。

pairs.target: nà shì jǐnián zhīqián qiān zhàn shí tiē de :
pairs.english: It had been posted when the station moved some years ago:
pairs.hanzi: 那是几年之前迁站时贴的：

pairs.target: shōu huòguì qiān dào pō shàng de wěi jiē , jiùzhǐ zhī liú báitiān kānshǒu ,
pairs.english: the receiving counter would move uphill to Reed Steps, with only daytime watch at the old site,
pairs.hanzi: 收货柜迁到坡上的苇阶，旧址只留白天看守，

pairs.target: línshí duīchǎng bùdé dǎngzhù jūmín liàng wǎng de kòngdì .
pairs.english: and temporary storage must not block residents' net-drying ground.
pairs.hanzi: 临时堆场不得挡住居民晾网的空地。

pairs.target: zuì xiàmiàn tiān zhe lín yuán de xiǎozì , shuō jiùzhǐ páng de rénjiā bìng méiyǒu dōu bānzǒu ,
pairs.english: In smaller writing at the bottom, Lin Yuan added that not all the households beside the old site had moved away;
pairs.hanzi: 最下面添着林沅的小字，说旧址旁的人家并没有都搬走，

pairs.target: wèn rén shí kěyǐ tuōshōu xìn chù wǎng xià dài huà .
pairs.english: inquiries could be sent down through the receiving office.
pairs.hanzi: 问人时可以托收信处往下带话。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi bǎ zhè zhāng zhǐ tān píng .
pairs.english: Tavi smoothed the page flat.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维把这张纸摊平。

pairs.target: gàoshì lǐ méiyǒu tóngnián de tā , què yǒu kānshǒu , huòguì hé bùxǔ zhàn de kòngdì .
pairs.english: The notice held no childhood Tavi, but it had a watchkeeper, a receiving counter, and ground that mustn't be occupied.
pairs.hanzi: 告示里没有童年的他，却有看守、货柜和不许占的空地。

pairs.target: nàge yìzhí suō zài chēpái shàng de dìfāng , dìyīcì lùchū le ménqián de záwù .
pairs.english: That place, always squeezed into a vehicle tag, had revealed its doorstep clutter for the first time.
pairs.hanzi: 那个一直缩在车牌上的地方，第一次露出了门前的杂物。

pairs.target: " wǒ xiǎng zài xiě . " tā shuō . " jiù xiànzài ? " " xiān gěi sè lā . "
pairs.english: “I want to write again,” he said. “Right now?” “To Sela first.”
pairs.hanzi:
“我想再写。”他说。
“就现在？”
“先给瑟拉。”

pairs.target: mǐlā zhè cái yǎoleyìkǒu miànbāo .
pairs.english: Only then did Mira bite into her bread.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉这才咬了一口面包。

pairs.target: yīwén qǐshēn qù jiè zhǐ , zǒu dào ménkǒu yòu huítóu , wèn yào buyào bǎ shuǐ huànchéng rè de .
pairs.english: Iven got up to borrow paper, then turned at the door to ask whether to replace the water with hot water.
pairs.hanzi: 伊文起身去借纸，走到门口又回头，问要不要把水换成热的。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi shuō búyòng , bǎ bēizi lājìn , hē le hǎojǐkǒu .
pairs.english: Tavi said no, pulled the cup closer, and drank several mouthfuls.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维说不用，把杯子拉近，喝了好几口。

pairs.target: gěi jiālǐ de xìn bùhǎo kāitóu .
pairs.english: The letter home was hard to begin.
pairs.hanzi: 给家里的信不好开头。

pairs.target: tā bùxiǎng xiěchéng yǒu le xiànsuǒ ,
pairs.english: He didn't want to write as though he had found a lead,
pairs.hanzi: 他不想写成有了线索，

pairs.target: gèng bùxiǎng ràng sè lā cóng biérén zuǐlǐ tīngjiàn , cái zhīdào zìjǐ zài zhǎo jiùzhàn de rén .
pairs.english: still less for Sela to learn from someone else that he was seeking people from the old station.
pairs.hanzi: 更不想让瑟拉从别人嘴里听见，才知道自己在找旧站的人。

pairs.target: zuìhòu tā xiě shōudào huíxìn le , méiyǒu zhǎodào rènshi tā de shuí ,
pairs.english: At last he wrote that a reply had arrived, but he hadn't found anyone who knew him,
pairs.hanzi: 最后他写收到回信了，没有找到认识他的谁，

pairs.target: zhī zhīdào nà kuài chēpái kěnéng cóng gèng yuǎn de dìfāng lái .
pairs.english: only learned that the vehicle tag might have come from farther away.
pairs.hanzi: 只知道那块车牌可能从更远的地方来。

pairs.target: tā bǎ " kěnéng " miáo zhòng le yìdiǎn , yòu xiě zìjǐ xiǎng wènqīng dàgài de niánfèn ,
pairs.english: He traced “might” a little darker, then wrote that he wanted to establish the approximate year,
pairs.hanzi: 他把“可能”描重了一点，又写自己想问清大概的年份，

pairs.target: wèn tā xiàcì jiàn bó yà shí néng bunéng yìqǐ xiǎngxiǎng .
pairs.english: and asked whether she and Boya could think it over together next time they met.
pairs.hanzi: 问她下次见博娅时能不能一起想想。

pairs.target: xiě dào zhèlǐ , tā tíngzhù , tiān shàng nàtiān shānlù shang méi láidejí jiǎng de shì :
pairs.english: Here he paused, adding something he hadn't had time to tell about the mountain road:
pairs.hanzi: 写到这里，他停住，添上那天山路上没来得及讲的事：

pairs.target: hòuchē pénglǐ yǒu gè lǎotàitài , bǎ liǎngzhī jī kàn dé bǐ zìjǐ de chēpiào hái jǐn .
pairs.english: an old woman in the waiting shelter had guarded two chickens more closely than her ticket.
pairs.hanzi: 候车棚里有个老太太，把两只鸡看得比自己的车票还紧。

pairs.target: lóuxià kāishǐ shōu wǎn .
pairs.english: Bowls were being cleared downstairs.
pairs.hanzi: 楼下开始收碗。

pairs.target: shào lǐ cóng yuànlǐ jīngguò , shǒulǐ ná zhe kǎohé chù de zhézhǐ .
pairs.english: Shaoli passed through the courtyard with a folded paper from the assessment office.
pairs.hanzi: 邵里从院里经过，手里拿着考核处的折纸。

pairs.target: tā táitóu kànjiàn tāmen , yáng le yáng zhǐ , méiyǒu hǎn .
pairs.english: Looking up and seeing them, he waved the paper without calling.
pairs.hanzi: 他抬头看见他们，扬了扬纸，没有喊。

pairs.target: qiántiān wǎnfàn shí , tā yǐjīng xiàng nà zhuō rén bǎ chuányán jiūzhèng le .
pairs.english: At dinner two days earlier, he had corrected the rumour for the people at that table.
pairs.hanzi: 前天晚饭时，他已经向那桌人把传言纠正了。

pairs.target: luò héng dāngchǎng bǔ le jìlù de rìqī .
pairs.english: Lohen had added the date of the record on the spot.
pairs.hanzi: 洛衡当场补了记录的日期。

pairs.target: jīntiān zhǔn tā xiānkǎo bù xū jiēchù de xiàngmù , jiè xìng yíxiàng lìng pái ;
pairs.english: Today he was allowed to take the non-contact sections first, with the exchange section rescheduled;
pairs.hanzi: 今天准他先考不需接触的项目，借性一项另排；

pairs.target: chéngnán de míngé hái méiyǒu dáfù .
pairs.english: the southern placement still had no answer.
pairs.hanzi: 城南的名额还没有答复。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi yě tái le táishǒu .
pairs.english: Tavi raised his hand too.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维也抬了抬手。

pairs.target: chuāngwài yǒurén bǎ yìzhāng zhuōzi bānjìn rìguāng lǐ ,
pairs.english: Outside the window, someone was carrying a table into the sunlight,
pairs.hanzi: 窗外有人把一张桌子搬进日光里，

pairs.target: zhuōjiǎo guā zhe shí dì , fèi le hǎo dà lìqi cái zhuǎnguò wān .
pairs.english: its feet scraping the stone as they struggled to turn the corner.
pairs.hanzi: 桌脚刮着石地，费了好大力气才转过弯。

pairs.target: tā bǎ méi chī wán de miànbāo dìgěi yīwén , chóngxīn zuòxià .
pairs.english: He handed Iven the unfinished bread and sat down again.
pairs.hanzi: 他把没吃完的面包递给伊文，重新坐下。

pairs.target: xìnzhǐ háiyǒu bànyè , zúgòu bǎ jī de shì xiě wán .
pairs.english: Half a page remained, enough to finish the story of the chickens.
pairs.hanzi: 信纸还有半页，足够把鸡的事写完。
